text:
Priyanka R: posting postmortem follow-up for the 03:12 UTC alert storm. keeping items small and actionable so we can ship fast.
Ethan K: saw a huge spike of duplicate pages. dedupe grouped badly because the fingerprint included trace_id and ephemeral host tags.
Liu Z: root cause: burst retries + very short dedupe window + paging policy that escalated every 2m. duplicates came from parallel retries across zones.
Priyanka R: propose concrete tasks (small PRs, owners, ETAs):
  1) Normalize dedupe fingerprint to stable keys (service, route, error_class) and remove trace_id. owner: Liu Z. ETA: 72h.
  2) Increase global dedupe window from 30s -> 210s and add a cross-region fingerprint key (cluster_id). owner: Ethan K. ETA: 4 days.
  3) Add a short "paging backoff" policy that delays escalations for non-critical alerts by 5m if the same alert has fired in the last 10m. owner: Priyanka R. ETA: 3 days.
  4) Create a suppression-candidate exporter that lists alerts firing >=6 times/24h and posts to #alerts-review (manual review only). owner: Ops Bot. ETA: 10 days.
Ethan K: ack. I'll open a routing PR with a feature flag so we can roll back quickly. sample config:```yaml
dedupe:
  window_seconds: 210
  signature_keys: [service, route, error_class, cluster_id]
  exclude_keys: [trace_id, host_id]
```
Liu Z: ack. for (1) I'll add unit tests asserting cross-region grouping and update the routing ff to default off. will include a migration note for any downstream consumers that used trace_id.
Priyanka R: for (3) paging backoff I'll add a policy layer in the paging-service and a small e2e test that simulates retry bursts. pseudo:```json
{
  "backoff": {"non_critical_seconds": 300, "threshold_window": 600}
}
```
Repo Bot: Created PR https://git.redwood/routing/pull/4105 (dedupe window + signature_keys).
Ops Bot: Created job https://git.redwood/ops/pull/282 (suppression-candidate exporter). posts weekly to #alerts-review.
Ethan K: safety net: add an "excess_suppression" alarm if suppressed pages >12% of total in 24h. owner: Ethan K. ETA: 1 week.
Liu Z: also adding a metric duplicate_alert_ratio and a dashboard tile so we can measure before/after effects. ETA: 5 days.
Priyanka R: optional: do a 5% canary rollout of the dedupe change for 48h and monitor duplicate_alert_ratio + user-facing error-rate. owner: Priyanka R. ETA: 2 weeks.
Ethan K: branch created: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-stable-210s (feature-flagged). running unit tests.
Liu Z: PR for removing trace_id from fingerprint: https://git.redwood/routing/pull/4110  includes tests and a migration note.
Priyanka R: paging backoff PR: https://git.redwood/paging/pull/97  includes policy config + e2e replay.
Ops Bot: suppression exporter merged to staging; will post first candidate list next Friday.
Priyanka R: scheduling a 15m sync in 48h to check progress and mark cards in the postmortem board. close this thread when PRs merged and the board reflects owners/due dates. :white_check_mark:
Ethan K: ack. I'll monitor the canary and be ready to flip the feature flag back if anything odd shows up.
Liu Z: adding a short runbook step for oncall: how to temporarily widen the dedupe window and disable backoff in emergencies.
Repo Bot: All CI checks passing for PRs listed above.
Priyanka R: thanks everyone. closing for now; reopen if we spot regressions during the canary or first weekly suppression run.
